## dockma.install

Download the Linux guest (dockma-linux) of this version into ~/.dockma/guest.

```
dockma install [--version] [--help]
```

Fetches dockma-linux-<version>-arm64.tar.gz from the GitHub release that matches `dockma --version`, checks it against the release's SHA256SUMS and replaces the installed guest. DOCKMA_RELEASE_URL points it at another directory of release assets.

**--version:**

*Show the version.*


**--help:**

*Show help information.*

## dockma.shell

Open a root shell in the VM, or run a command there.

```
dockma shell [--tty] [--no-tty] [<command>...] [--version] [--help]
```

Without a command, opens an interactive login shell. With `-- <command>`, runs the command, passes stdin/stdout/stderr through and exits with its exit code. Works even when dockerd is down.

**--tty:**

*Force a pseudo-terminal.*


**--no-tty:**

*Disable the pseudo-terminal.*


**command:**

*Command to run instead of a shell (after --).*


**--version:**

*Show the version.*


**--help:**

*Show help information.*

## dockma.config

Show or change VM settings (applied on the next start).

```
dockma config [--cpus=<cpus>] [--memory=<memory>] [--disk=<disk>]
  [--port-bind-address=<port-bind-address>] [--rosetta=<rosetta>]
  [--autostart=<autostart>] [--version] [--help]
```

**--cpus=\<cpus\>:**

*Number of virtual CPUs.*


**--memory=\<memory\>:**

*Memory in MiB.*


**--disk=\<disk\>:**

*Data disk size in GiB (can only grow).*


**--port-bind-address=\<port-bind-address\>:**

*Host address published ports are bound to: 127.0.0.1 (this Mac only), 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces) or one interface's address.*


**--rosetta=\<rosetta\>:**

*Run amd64 images with Rosetta (true/false).*


**--autostart=\<autostart\>:**

*Start dockma at login (true/false).*


**--version:**

*Show the version.*


**--help:**

*Show help information.*
